metadata.name: JLPT N5 kanji import data by Kanji Master N5
metadata.source_note: Topic/chapter structure and the 118 index kanji follow the scanned Kanji Master N5 textbook. The PDF has no text layer, so vocabulary and Vietnamese examples were prepared as learning data.
metadata.enrichment_source: https://kanjiapi.dev/ for stroke counts and on/kun readings
notes: kanji_topics.name is Japanese-first; kanji_topics.name_vi is the Vietnamese subtitle.
Each kanji has at least two learning words and generated example_* fields.
